title: The Last Hoard
text: A dead dragon's hoard lies unguarded in the cave, gold to the knee, cups and crowns and coins glittering in the torchlight. The dragon's bones are curled around it like a cat around her kittens. The eye sockets of its skull glow faintly.

options.label: Take what can be carried; the dragon is dead, after all.

outcomes.text: You fill pockets, packs and boots with gold. The skull watches and does nothing.

options.label: The strongest takes only a bone and leaves the gold to the dead.

outcomes.text: The wyrmbone is heavy as iron and twice as hard. The skull's glow dims, almost approvingly.

options.label: Leave it all to the dead. Some hoards should stay hoarded.

outcomes.text: You go on with empty pockets and a lighter heart. Behind you, something in the cave sighs, content.
